name: Spellbound Butlers
source:
For as long as you can remember, strange things have happened to you—inexplicable moments that might make you question your sanity, if they weren’t so fleeting and harmless. Never in your wildest dreams did you think they might point to a secret from your past that upends everything you take for granted in life and the very nature of reality itself. After all, magic isn’t real… is it?

When a mysterious letter arrives that seems to bequeath you ownership of a lavish estate, the temptation to find out more about your true origins lures you into a world more spellbinding than anything you imagined possible. Even with three handsome and dutiful butlers eager to satisfy your every want and need, there may yet be threats even a promising mage can’t overcome.

In a world of magic and illusion, how can you ever truly know which charming faces to trust?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.newbutler]Google Play[/url]]
